title: Differential Golden-Seed Smoke Harness for Streaming + Function-call Compatibility
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Recent runtime changes to partial-chunk streaming and tool/function call interleaving have produced non-deterministic interleavings across model versions. We need a fast-running smoke harness that uses small but targeted 'differential' golden seeds to detect regressions in streaming framing, partial JSON recovery, and tool-call boundary markers across supported model variants and protocol adapters.

Goal: Build a lightweight harness integrated into CI that: (1) runs ~10 deterministic golden seeds with controlled jitter and simulated partial-chunking, (2) compares structured output tokens and toolcall metadata across model shims, (3) produces a fingerprint diff report and triage hints for flaky vs deterministic regressions.
acceptance_criteria:
1) CI job 'stream-diff-smoke' runs in <15 minutes on CI pool and exits non-zero on behavioral fingerprint drift for any seeded scenario.
2) Each failing seed includes: (a) canonical seed input, (b) model variant & runtime flags, (c) token-level diff (prefix/KV alignment), (d) suggested triage label (protocol, kernel-schedule, serializer).
3) Integration with existing canary dashboard: failures create a ticket with links to failing run artifacts and a recommended rollback model variant if severity == high.
tasks: Design differential golden seed corpus (10 seeds) covering: partial JSON end-of-chunk, mid-token toolcall boundaries, KV-cache priming edgecases
Implement harness runner: shim executor that can vary chunk sizes, introduce artificial network jitter, and capture token-level events
Integrate serializer/ndjson linter to assert structured-output roundtrip or produce graceful fallback trace
Add fingerprinting logic: produce compact hash + token-diff for human triage
Wire CI job and artifact upload to S3; add Slack alerting integration for P1 failures

notes: Avoid long-running golden corpora; goal is smoke-level detection. Use replayable seeds and store captured token streams as ndjson for forensic replay.
